en: A black-and-white postcard-style image showing a large wooden manor house behind leafless trees and a simple wooden fence. The house has two stories, a central entrance with a small porch, many windows, and surrounding verandas. A driveway or path leads up to the entrance, and the trees suggest a park-like setting. At the top of the image is printed text reading "Herrgården Vivstavavv" (likely a slight blur of Vivstavarv).
